direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; enlarge the rendered scene to at least 70% of main, with independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs and no overlap; keep side content condensed inside its reserved zone without reliance on inspector scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A as sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum and no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow with state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no unsupported loops beyond live flow; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, scene nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional scene-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; full-shop cascade preserves readable department titles and machine counts at 1366x768

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene within its reserved zone and add living emerald material flow plus soft state glow so Receiving, cells and jobs read as one cinematic line at 1366x768.
Raise rail and side-zone body copy to a firm 16px/24 and keep the metrics 70, 2 and 36h aligned to the Certificate and Receiving tracks.
Add a persistent legend with pattern, marker and text for Held, Available and At Risk, with a 2px emerald focus ring on each scene node.
Separate provider identity readiness from the investigation evidence task in the side zone, each with its own heading, status and control.
Make verified findings legible at 16px/24: enlarge the 0, 0 and 3 metric cards and state plainly what was verified, rejected and left feasible.
Link each finding on selection to a glowing scene node and route trace, settling to static under reduced motion.
On selecting a path, surface the one-click Approve followed by the Authorize this decision wall, keeping No acceptance recorded until that wall completes.
Give the chosen path a stronger emerald fill, deeper panel lift and route glow across the affected cells and jobs before approval.
Keep the three trade-off cards at equal height with 26px tabular finish and cost figures so 83h, 35h and 17.5h compare instantly.
Add depth and a brief cinematic build transition as the three proposed tasks assemble, with dashed silver borders reinforcing untracked until approval.
Clarify the progress bars on t1 to t3 so partial fill cannot be read as tracked completion before approval.
Tighten side-zone duplication of the board status to one concise summary at 16px/24, preserving room for the scene.
Add an explicit x cross marker beside the silver cross-hatching and plain OFFLINE text on CELL-MILL-2 in both preview and applied states.
Animate the capacity preview 24h to 0h as a single state-driven transition, then hold static, with the flow rerouting in emerald around the stopped cell.
Enlarge the machine selector label and value to 16px and add a visible focus ring for keyboard selection.
Keep provider identity readiness visually distinct from reinvestigation, and make Reinvestigate recovery explain that 3 paths became 2 feasible paths.
Strengthen the OFFLINE treatment with a clearer x cross marker over the silver hatching and ensure no feasible route passes through CELL-MILL-2.
Mark Split available capacity as constrained directly on its scene card with pattern and text, not colour alone.
Give the two feasible revised paths a subtle emerald route glow while the constrained path stays silver-hatched with its reason in plain text.
On selecting a revised path, proceed to one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall, retaining Prior acceptance invalidated until completion.
Align the scene option cards exactly with the side-zone comparison rows for bidirectional highlighting.
Visually distinguish the 3 blocked prior tasks from the 3 proposed replacements with silver hatching and Blocked text alongside the dashed proposed styling.
Restate Approved revised plan beside replacement tasks await approval so the coexisting states read without inference.
Add a short cinematic replan transition on the board, removed under reduced motion, with task order and dependencies traced once.
Add state glow to the active Verify ledger stage and a completed emerald trace across 01 to 03 as each stage unlocks.
Enlarge the passphrase guidance and field label to 16px/24 and keep checklist errors announced with aria-live polite.
Clarify the footer counts 3 tracked, 0 done and 0 blocked against the board state in one short status sentence.
Refit department cards inside the viewport so titles such as Saw, CNC mills, CNC lathes, Heat treat, Inspection, Finishing and Assembly are never clipped at the top.

Make the cascade legible: show living emerald flow across running departments first, then silver cross-hatching, x markers and plain OFFLINE text as the failure wave lands, then recovery restarting the line.
Correct conflicting machine counts inside each department card and enlarge count text to at least 12px, with running and offline totals matching the legend.
Enlarge the embedded full-shop cascade image or add a larger linked view so department names, OFFLINE labels and running counts stay legible without zooming.
Add short captions beneath the hero and cascade visuals naming the discrepancy, the shock and the recovery restart in sequence.
Tighten the opening metrics row into one scannable line at 16px so the Live demo link is reached faster within the required order.
